name: AO2027
description: AO2027, Argentum Online's world on a modern server (CoverAO, its port to .NET), installed from its GitHub releases. Players play with the game's desktop app, CoverAO, from the same releases: they add the server by its address and Game port. Game masters and the other settings are in CoverAO-win-x64/Server.ini. Characters and accounts are in the game's own SQLite file, or in a PostgreSQL database chosen in the server's Databases tab, which takes the SQLite file's characters at its first start.

variables.label: Player limit
variables.description: 0 for none. Left empty, MaxUsers stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Experience multiplier
variables.description: How many times the experience each creature gives: 1 is normal. Left empty, Exp stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Gold multiplier
variables.description: How many times the gold each creature gives: 1 is normal. Left empty, Oro stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: New characters
variables.description: Whether players may create characters. Left empty, PuedeCrearPersonajes stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Game masters only
variables.description: Only game masters can log in. Left empty, ServerSoloGMs stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Bots
variables.description: Characters that play by themselves so the world does not look empty; each takes a player slot. 0 for none, up to 96. Left empty, Bots stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Day length (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes a whole day lasts: dawn, day, dusk and night. Left empty, MinutosDelDia stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Weather change (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes between weather changes. Left empty, MinutosDeClima stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Rain (%)
variables.description: How often a weather change brings rain, from 0 to 100. Left empty, PorcentajeLluvia stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Global drop
variables.description: One in this many creatures killed also drops an item of the global drop table. 0 turns it off. Left empty, DropGlobal stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Campfire (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes a campfire burns before it goes out. 0: it never goes out, as in the original. Left empty, MinutosDeFogata stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Items on the floor survive restarts
variables.description: What players dropped on the floor is still there after the server restarts. Left empty, PersistirSuelo stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Sailing to cross the sea
variables.description: Sailing points the passages to another land ask for. 0 asks for none, as in the original. Left empty, NavegacionParaCruzar stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Gold on level up
variables.description: Gold a character gets as a gift each time it levels up. 0 gives none, as in the original. Left empty, OroAlSubirNivel stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Full heal on level up
variables.description: Leveling up fills health, mana and stamina. Off, as in the original, it fills health only. Left empty, CuraAlSubirNivel stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Remove newbie items
variables.description: Past level 15 the (Newbies) items disappear, and only those. Off, as in the original, they stay. Left empty, QuitarEquipoNovato stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Anti-macro sentinel
variables.description: A sentinel asks whoever is working to type /CENTINELA with a code; who does not answer in two minutes goes to jail. Left empty, Centinela stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Familiar seeks enemies
variables.description: The familiar goes after the hostile creature nearest its owner. Off, as in the original, it only fights its owner's target. Left empty, FamiliarBusca stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Druid's metamorphosis
variables.description: -1: permanent, as in classic AO; 0: off; or the seconds it lasts. Left empty, MetamorfosisDelDruida stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Rinkel passes
variables.description: The two passes the pirate in Rinkel's port sells can be used. Off, as in the original data, they cannot. Left empty, PasesDeRinkel stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Seahorses in open sea
variables.description: Fishing with a net in open sea brings up seahorses instead of the usual fish. Left empty, HipocamposEnMarAbierto stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: City guards attack
variables.description: The cities' guards attack the sides they are against. Off, as in the original, they do not attack. Left empty, GuardiasAtacan stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Guards chase
variables.description: A guard who sees an enemy chases it while it stays in the city, then goes back to its post. Off, they stay put. Left empty, GuardiasPersiguen stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Guards attack newbies
variables.description: Guards also attack newbies (up to level 15) of the other side. Left empty, GuardiasAtacanNewbies stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Imperial guards attack
variables.description: The factions the imperial guards attack, comma-separated, as the game names them: Renegado, Ciudadano, Republicano, Caos, Armada, Milicia. Left empty, GuardiasImperialesAtacanA stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Republican guards attack
variables.description: The factions the republican guards attack, comma-separated, as the game names them: Renegado, Ciudadano, Republicano, Caos, Armada, Milicia. Left empty, GuardiasRepublicanosAtacanA stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Chaos guards attack
variables.description: The factions the guards of Chaos attack, comma-separated, as the game names them: Renegado, Ciudadano, Republicano, Caos, Armada, Milicia. Left empty, GuardiasDelCaosAtacanA stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Several connections per IP
variables.description: Off: one connection per IP. Left empty, AllowMultiLogins stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Connections per IP
variables.description: Most sockets one IP may have open, including those not signed in yet. 0: 10, as in the original. Left empty, LimiteConexionesPorIp stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Characters per IP
variables.description: Characters from one IP playing at the same time. 0 for no limit. Left empty, MaxPersonajesPorIp stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: New accounts per IP
variables.description: Accounts one IP may create every ten minutes. 0 for no limit. Left empty, CuentasNuevasPorIp stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Idle limit (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes without activity before a player is disconnected. 0: never. Left empty, IdleLimit stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Cheats to kick
variables.description: Cheats detected on an account before each new one kicks it out. 0 turns this step off. Left empty, TrampasParaEchar stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Cheats to ban
variables.description: Cheats detected on an account before the account and its character are banned. 0 turns this step off. Left empty, TrampasParaBanear stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Shortest password
variables.description: Fewest characters a player's password may have. Left empty, ClaveMinima stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Save characters (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes between saves of the characters online. 0 turns it off. Left empty, MinutosGuardarUsuarios stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Game's world copy (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes between the game's own copies of the world in data/backups (Pulsar's backups are apart). 0 turns them off. Left empty, MinutosBackup stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Game's world copies to keep
variables.description: How many of the game's own world copies to keep. 0 keeps them all. Left empty, BackupsAConservar stays as Server.ini has it.

variables.label: Log days
variables.description: Days of the game's logs in data/logs to keep. 0: console only. Left empty, LogDias stays as Server.ini has it.

ports.name: base
ports.label: Base port
ports.description: StartPort in Server.ini: the other three follow it. The classic Windows client cannot log in to this server, so it stays closed.

ports.name: websocket
ports.label: WebSocket
ports.description: Kept for older clients: the app plays through the Game port.

ports.name: admin
ports.label: Admin panel
ports.description: The game's own admin panel, on this machine only. Its token is in the console at every start.

ports.name: game
ports.label: Game
ports.description: Players add the server in the CoverAO app as <address>:<port>, for example 190.1.2.3:7669.
